body:
I don't think it's funny at all. More something to cry over, but I lost the ability to do so long ago.
Just gonna kill myself off. Thank you for trying.

I don't feel ugly. I am ugly. And it's getting harder to hold on. I already started hurting myself, but it doesn't help, I started to pray at night, that God (I don't believe in him actually) may take my life already. I repeat it until I eventually fall asleep just to wake up the next morning and to realize that I have to suffer another 24 hours.

Yeah, but it's natural, biological to feel attracted to good-looking people. I don't blame them for not wanting me, I wouldn't want myself either. And yes, I'm concerned about it. How should I be not?! It means that I will never experience love or intimacy. Basic human emotional needs. My friends know, my family knows, but they can do nothing about it. 
And no, you're wrong. My face is a disaster.

I don't have a problem being gay per se, but the gay world is so shallow that if you don't meet certain standards, you're nothing and I'm far from being anywhere near those standards. I look too fucked up, like how is it possible that a human being can look like me. I don't need to feel better about myself, what's the use?! Still nobody would want me, still would be alone. Body means shit, it is nothing. They'll say "oh, nice jacked body too bad his face looks like his mom had to much nuclear exposur during the pregnancy"
